facts.fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 19.8 per cent of tertiary graduates in Seychelles in 2021, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 26.2 per cent of tertiary graduates in Seychelles in 2022, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 27.2 per cent of tertiary graduates in Seychelles in 2023, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 18.5 per cent of tertiary graduates in Seychelles in 2024, by UNESCO's series.
